Statement of director's responsibilities The director is responsible for preparing the Annual Report and the financial statements in accordance with applicable law and regulations. Company law requires the director to prepare financial statements for each financial year. Under that law the director has elected to prepare the financial statements in accordance with United Kingdom Generally Accepted Accounting Practice (United Kingdom Accounting Standards and applicable law). Under company law the director must not approve the financial statements unless he is satisfied that they give a true and fair view of the state of affairs of the group and company, and of the profit or loss of the group for that period. sections.strategic_report: strategic report for the year ended 30 June 2025. Review of the business - Group The company was incorporated on 14 June 2023. During the previous period the company acquired shares at deemed fair value in Fleetwood Wanderers Limited, The Leisure Channel Ltd and Power Grade Limited. The company from herein is an investment holding company . Details of the subsidiaries are provided in note 15 . Review of the business - Fleetwood Wanderers Limited The club commenced the 2024/25 season with Charlie Adam as Head Coach, starting their first season in the EFL Sky Bet League Two since 2014. The club ended the season with Peter Wild as Head Coach. The club continues to invest strongly in the academy, maintaining category 2 status being one of only three clubs to hold this status whilst playing in the EFL Sky Bet League Two. In line with the club’s business model of investing into the academy through personnel and infrastructure, the club continues to realise income from the sale of academy players and negotiated transfer clauses on those players, allowing for significant future sell on percentages and other ongoing payments, contingent on the performances of those players at their new clubs. The expectation is that this income stream will continue to the benefit of the club year on year, both from the future movement of players sold and with more academy players playing for the 1 st team, through this continued investment and development of new young talent at the club. Several academy players made their 1 st team debuts, illustrating the ongoing success of the commitment to invest in the development of the club and its players. The club continued to work with Waterford FC, Ireland, in a collaboration to extend the recruitment and development options for the club. The link saw a number of players transfer between the clubs during the season. The club continues to utilise the Poolfoot Farm Training Facility, ensuring that state-of-the-art facilities are available throughout the whole club structure from the 1 st team to all age groups throughout the academy. Review of the business - Power Grade Limited Waterford Football Club is an Irish association football club based in Waterford, Ireland, competing in the League of Ireland Premier Division. Following promotion to the Premier Division, the club finished 7th in the 2024 season and subsequently retained its status for the 2026 season, finishing 9th in the 2025 league campaign and securing survival via the relegation play-off. The club continues to operate in conjunction with its sister club, Fleetwood Town, with arrangements in place for the sharing of expertise and the movement of players between the two clubs. This structure supports player development and squad management. During the 2025 financial period, the club established a Women’s Team, which competed in the League of Ireland Women’s Premier Division for the first time. In addition, the club implemented a number of operational developments, including obtaining the appropriate licensing to permit alcohol sales on match days, expanding food and beverage provision, and introducing an updated ticketing system and website platform. These activities represent continued operational development of the club across both sporting and commercial functions during the period. THE WILLOWS 96 HOLDINGS LTD
